messages:
julia (eng-runtime): morning — quick sync on kernel perf + KV prefetch. small checklist: 1) kernel patch (perf + GSO) 2) kv prefetch toggles 3) continuous-batching rollout window. owners pls confirm ETA & blockers. @ben @alice @mike

ben (kernel): PR: https://github.com/redwood/re/runtime/pull/492 :eyes: CI flaky on A100 tests. ETA end of day if tests pass. need one LG from @oliver.

oliver (eng-runtime): will review today, prioritizing the atomic GSO test. heads-up: saw 2% regression on seq=8192 in synthetic bench — investigating.

alice (kv-cache): kv prefetch feature flag landed to staging. experiments show 18% token savings on chat-heavy traffic. parity tests show a small tail-skew when cache misses + batching concurrently.

mike (eng-platform): dependency: we need a config rollout via infra-configs service for the flag. @sarah can we get a canary tomorrow 10–12 PT? also need dedicated route mapping for canary to avoid noisy customers.

sarah (eng-sre): can do 10–12 PT tomorrow for a 2-hour canary. will monitor p99 and error budget. create runbook snippet pls.

julia (eng-runtime): thanks. runbook draft — paste below for canary ops
```text
- start canary: deploy kernel PR + enable kv-prefetch on canary routes
- traffic: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 30m
- monitor: p50/p95/p99 latency, OOMs, error-rate
- rollback: toggle flag off + rollback kernel
```

ben (kernel): FYI repro command I used:
```bash
./bench_runner --model redwood-v1 --seq-len 8192 --batch 4 --runs 10
```
if you see KV miss storms, check kv-hit-rate metric.

oliver (eng-runtime): reviewed, left CR comments on inline diffs. main ask: atomic GSO fallback path needs a comment & test. otherwise LGTM pending CI.

alice (kv-cache): note: prefix caching interacts with continuous-batching buffer sizing. suggestion: limit batch size to 6 for canary to reduce head-of-line blocking.

julia (eng-runtime): action items: @ben fix tests + add atomic fallback test; @oliver CR; @mike schedule canary; @alice add batch-size override; @sarah run canary monitoring. I'll update the sprint board. ping back in-thread when each item is done :thumbsup: 

devops-bot: deployment scheduled for 2026-03-18 17:00 UTC (canary window reserved) — ID: dep-7892

mike (eng-platform): scheduled. created infra-configs PR for canary routing: https://git.company/infra-configs/pull/203

sarah (eng-sre): added alert dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/s/kv-canary

oliver (eng-runtime): CR done, pushed fix for test. @ben please rebase.

ben (kernel): rebased + CI passing on staging. marking complete in sprint board.

julia (eng-runtime): awesome, thanks all. will close this thread after post-canary notes. :sparkles:
